headline: Four steps. Then it works in the background.

step01.title: Create your card
step01.description: Sign up with Google or Apple. Your business card builds itself.

step02.title: Import everyone
step02.description: Phone, Telegram, LinkedIn, CSV. Bulk in one tap. Naura dedupes.

step03.title: AI tags & organizes
step03.description: Roles, interests, cities, when you met. Editable. Yours.

step04.title: Search · remind · ask
step04.description: Find a path. Get nudged. Ask your network from the chat bar.
